messages.content: Answer in English: According to Windows验收_ViT.pdf, which three datasets are used for pre-training, and how large are they?

## Answer
The three datasets used for pre-training are ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet, ImageNet-21k, and JFT. [参考文档2：Windows验收\_ViT.pdf；第7页（物理页码）]

- ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset has 1k classes and 1.3M images.
- ImageNet-21k dataset has 21k classes and 14M images.
- JFT dataset has 18k classes. [参考文档2：Windows验收\_ViT.pdf；第7页（物理页码）]

## 参考来源
- [参考文档2] Windows验收\_ViT.pdf；第7页（物理页码）
